summary: Workflow and PowerShell production code are excellent—proper error handling, clear separation of concerns, and strong conventions (Set-StrictMode, $ErrorActionPreference, least-privilege perms, pinned action refs). run-act-tests.sh is well-designed (set -euo pipefail, proper quoting, good test factoring) but references missing infrastructure files (.actrc at line 65, LicenseChecker.Tests.ps1 at line 61) which would prevent it from running. The test fixtures and assertion patterns are sound. Deduct slightly on conciseness: test fixture write_fixtures() could use data-driven approach instead of case statements; maintainability deduction for incomplete test harness infrastructure despite solid production code design.
